summary: Western Midstream Partners, LP filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, Western Midstream Operating, LP, completed a public offering of $700 million aggregate principal amount of 5.700% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes, governed by an indenture supplemented by a sixteenth supplemental indenture, rank equally with existing senior indebtedness. Interest accrues from June 25, 2026, payable semi-annually, with maturity on July 1, 2036. The registrant is the issuer. This is a routine debt financing not constituting a special situation; there is no change of control or strategic event. No further action or watch items arise.
